steps.tx: The **2016 revised ACR diagnostic criteria** define fibromyalgia by a **Widespread Pain Index of 7 or more** and **Symptom Severity Scale score of 5 or more**, or alternatively a WPI of 4 to 6 with SSS score of **9 or more**. Pain must be generalized across at least **4 of 5 defined body regions** and persist for at least **3 months**.
steps.say: The 2016 revised criteria define fibromyalgia using the Widespread Pain Index and Symptom Severity Scale. Generalized pain must span at least 4 of 5 body regions for 3 months.

rows: WPI >=7 with SSS >=5, OR WPI 4-6 with SSS >=9
Assesses fatigue, waking unrefreshed, cognitive symptoms
Scored 0 to 3 for each core symptom
Generalized pain in >=4 of 5 anatomical regions
Excludes isolated localized regional pain syndromes
Eliminates transient post-viral or acute myalgias

steps.tx: **Central sensitization** is the neurobiological core of fibromyalgia, driven by impaired descending serotonergic and noradrenergic pain-inhibitory pathways. Cerebrospinal fluid analysis reveals significantly elevated concentrations of excitatory neurotransmitters including **substance P**, **glutamate**, and **nerve growth factor**, amplifying nociceptive signal transmission in the dorsal horn.
steps.say: Central sensitization is marked by deficient descending inhibitory pathways and elevated excitatory transmitters. CSF analysis demonstrates elevated substance P, glutamate, and nerve growth factor.

vis.alt: Neurobiology of central sensitization and neurotransmitter imbalances in fibromyalgia
vis.caption: Central sensitization is characterized by deficient inhibitory control and elevated excitatory transmitters. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: Functional magnetic resonance imaging or fMRI during sensory pain processing demonstrates aberrant neural activation in the **insula**, **anterior cingulate cortex**, and primary somatosensory cortex at low stimulus pressures. This cerebral hyperresponsiveness objectively validates true mechanical and thermal **allodynia** and hyperalgesia in patients with fibromyalgia.
steps.say: Functional MRI demonstrates hyperactivation in the insula and anterior cingulate cortex during low stimulus pressures. This confirms mechanical allodynia and altered central processing.

nodes.label: Low stimulus pressure applied to peripheral tender points
fMRI hyperactivation in insula and anterior cingulate cortex confirming allodynia

steps.tx: **Pregabalin** is an approved alpha-2-delta ligand that binds presynaptic voltage-gated calcium channels in the spinal cord, decreasing calcium influx and suppressing excitatory neurotransmitter release. Dosed at **300 to 450 mg/day divided twice daily**, pregabalin significantly alleviates widespread pain, reduces sleep disruption, and improves functional status.
steps.say: Pregabalin binds alpha-2-delta calcium channels to decrease excitatory neurotransmitter release. Dosed at 300 to 450 mg daily, it improves pain and restorative sleep.

left.title: Pregabalin pharmacology
points: Target dose 300 to 450 mg daily divided twice daily
Binds alpha-2-delta subunit of calcium channels
Suppresses glutamate, substance P, and noradrenaline

right.title: Clinical considerations
points: Gradual upward dose titration minimizes dizziness
Side effects: somnolence, peripheral edema, weight gain
Excreted renally; requires dose adjustment in renal impairment

steps.tx: **Duloxetine** is a balanced dual serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor approved for fibromyalgia. Administered at **60 mg once daily**, duloxetine reinforces descending noradrenergic and serotonergic bulbospinal inhibitory pain pathways, significantly reducing chronic widespread pain scores and fatigue independently of baseline depression scores.
steps.say: Duloxetine is a serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor dosed at 60 mg once daily. It reinforces descending pain-inhibitory pathways to reduce widespread pain and fatigue.

nodes.label: Duloxetine 60 mg daily inhibits presynaptic serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake
Enhanced synaptic transmitter levels in descending bulbospinal tract
Inhibition of dorsal horn nociceptive transmission and pain reduction

steps.tx: **Milnacipran** is an alternative SNRI with higher relative selectivity for norepinephrine reuptake inhibition compared to serotonin. Dosed at **100 to 200 mg/day divided twice daily**, milnacipran enhances descending adrenergic inhibition, producing marked improvements in patient global impression of change, cognitive dysfunction or fibro-fog, and chronic widespread pain.
steps.say: Milnacipran is an SNRI with strong norepinephrine selectivity dosed at 100 to 200 mg daily. It improves chronic widespread pain, fatigue, and cognitive dysfunction.

rows: 300 to 450 mg daily in divided doses
100 to 200 mg daily in divided doses

steps.tx: Non-pharmacological management receives the strongest EULAR recommendation. Core interventions comprise low-impact **aerobic exercise** such as walking, swimming, or cycling performed for **at least 150 minutes per week**, alongside **cognitive behavioral therapy** or CBT to modify maladaptive pain catastrophizing and promote restorative sleep hygiene.
steps.say: Non-pharmacological therapies have the strongest EULAR recommendation. Prescribing 150 minutes weekly of low-impact aerobic exercise and cognitive behavioral therapy is essential.

rows: Grade A recommendation for mood and coping
Heated pool therapy 2 to 3 sessions weekly
Improves stiffness and immediate pain relief

steps.tx: **Opioids and systemic corticosteroids** demonstrate zero clinical efficacy against central pain processing in fibromyalgia and are **strongly contraindicated**. Opioids exacerbate opioid-induced hyperalgesia, promote severe physical dependence, and worsen cognitive impairment, while systemic corticosteroids incur severe metabolic toxicities without analgesic benefit.
steps.say: Opioids and systemic corticosteroids are ineffective in fibromyalgia and strongly contraindicated. Opioids trigger hyperalgesia and dependence while steroids carry high toxicity.

left.title: Contraindicated: Opioids
points: High risk of physical dependence and addiction

right.title: Contraindicated: Glucocorticoids
points: Zero analgesic benefit in clinical trials
Incurs osteoporosis, avascular necrosis, and diabetes
